correctness.rationale: For each of the five distinct automorphism orbits of unordered leaders, effective resistance to the added grounded node is δ+(x+r)(d−x+r)/(d+2r). Explicit rational sums eliminate HS, LL and LS by strictly positive differences. Independently recomputed all four asserted symbolic rational differences with SymPy, each simplifying exactly to zero. The surviving HH–HL sign is −P_m/((b+2r)(b+2r+1)); discriminant and positive-root arguments correctly cover b≤1/(m−1), the nonempty reentrant interval, the double root, and b above the critical value. m=2,b=6/5 has roots (5±sqrt(13))/10 and independently computed signs at r=1/20,1/2,2 are +,−,+ for P_m, yielding HH,HL,HH. Expansion b_c−b_0=1/(2m³)+O(m^−4) checked symbolically. Finite matrix orbits supplement the universally quantified algebraic proof.
